profile.headline: Lead Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’m a senior IT professional with more than 15 years of experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise software and data solutions. My background combines software development, database engineering, and systems integration, with a strong focus on Microsoft technologies.

I specialize in SQL Server development and administration, data integration, and enterprise system integrations. My work often involves designing data pipelines, building integrations between platforms, and supporting applications that are critical to daily business operations.

In my current role as Lead Senior Software Developer, I work closely with cross-functional teams to design solutions, troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver reliable systems that support production and operational workflows.

My core areas of experience include:

• SQL Server development, T-SQL, and database performance optimization
• Data integration and ETL solutions using SSIS and Azure Data Factory
• Application development using .NET and Visual Studio
• Enterprise integrations involving Oracle Fusion and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
• Reporting and analytics using SSRS and business intelligence tools
• Systems integration across enterprise platforms such as Dynamics 365 and Oracle Fusion

I enjoy solving complex technical problems, improving system performance, and building solutions that make business processes more efficient and reliable.

positions.title: Lead Sr. Software Developer
positions.insights: Azure Data Factory, Integration and +3 skills

positions.title: R&D Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Project Manager focusing on software development. Define tasks, milestones and indicators of success. 
•	New requirements designing and development. Creation of DB structures, database administration and optimization.
•	Design and maintain database models (ER).
•	Manage human and technological resource. 
•	Research and testing of new technological tools.
•	Create designs and technical specifications for new developments.
•	Provide support and maintenance of XSales® Suite (www.xsales.biz) for clients.
•	Support sales staff in sales presentation of XSales® Suite products.
Participation in several projects including:
•	Project Leader in development and implementation of Business Intelligence XSales® Suite, using the following technologies: SSIS, SSAS.
•	Development of an integration mechanism to transfer data from XSales® Suite databases to the Mobile Devices using SAP Mobile Platform (SMP).
•	Design and construct the concurrent synchronization tool for mobile devices under Windows Mobile and Windows Phone, using the following technologies: MS SQL Server, Managed Store Procedures, MS Visual Studio. NET C#, CCR Toolkit, XML.
•	Design and construct the concurrent synchronization tool for Android mobile devices, using the following technologies: Java Standard Edition, JPA.
•	Development of Web Services under MS .Net C# to support mobile device data requirements.
•	Project Leader conducting the certification for SAP Integration Certification between the application of XSales ® Suite with SAP Business One and Sybase Unwired Platform.
•	Project leader conducting developing teams under the outsourcing mode in: Argentina, India and Croatia. 
•	Responsible for defining requirements, development standards, technologies and tools to use, test definition and product release.

positions.title: Mobile Solutions Engineer Sr
positions.description:
•	Analyzed, designed and developed the interfaces between XSales® Suite and different Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): Exact Globe, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics GP. Tools used during the development: MS Visual Studio. NET C#, Altova MapForce, MS SQL Server. These solutions were successfully implemented at relevant clients such as Empresas Polar (Venezuela), Heineken Caribbean (Aruba, Curacao, Suriname, Puerto Rico, Bahamas, and St. Martin), Cadbury Adams (Venezuela), Romar trading (Aruba), and Grace Kennedy (Jamaica).
•	Coordinated training sessions both technical / functional for clients and partners to develop the interfaces between XSales® Product Suite and other ERP’s.
•	Developed technical training materials of XSales® Suite and conducted the training to the clients’ IT Department

positions.title: Mobile Solutions Consultant
positions.description:
•	Functional Consultant in the areas of sales and distribution.  Participated on the implementation and go-live of automating the sales force with applications, ICE and XSales® Suite, at consumer companies in Venezuela such as Empresas Polar, P&G, Alfonzo Rivas & Cia, and Dominican Republic: Mercasid and Induveca.
•	Defined and documented technical and functional customer requirements.
•	Continuously monitored the progress of the ongoing projects, by evaluating their activities and the quality of the deliverables. Tracked the solution issues and provided corrective actions when necessary.
•	Designed presentations, demo data preparation and conducted training sessions.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: •	Design, development and support of new requirements to a postpaid billing system for Movistar Venezuela. The requirements involved creation of new tables, add/remove fields from tables, and adjust procedures to save into database.
